fields.Name: Collaboration Home Counts
fields.Description: One row for one person across every space they reach: the Shared files, the open tasks (neither completed nor cancelled) and the invitations waiting on an owner. Built on fnCollaborationAccess. An MJ query is not bound by row filters and takes whatever UserID it is given, so only the Integration role may run it: the server runs it as the system user, with the signed-in person's own id, through GetHomeCounts.
fields.SQL:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceItem] i
       INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = i.SpaceID
       INNER JOIN [__mj].[File] f ON f.ID = TRY_CAST(REPLACE(i.RecordID, N'ID|', N'') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
      WHERE i.Band = N'Shared') AS SharedFiles,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceItem] i
       INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = i.SpaceID
       INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[Task] t ON t.ID = TRY_CAST(REPLACE(i.RecordID, N'ID|', N'') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
      WHERE (i.Band = N'Shared' OR a.CanSeeTeam = 1)
        AND t.Status NOT IN (N'Completed', N'Cancelled')) AS OpenTasks,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceMember] m
       INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = m.SpaceID
      WHERE m.Status = N'Invited'
        AND a.CanInvite = 1
        AND m.UserID <> TRY_CAST({{ UserID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) AS AwaitingApproval
